VanillaPsycastsExpanded.PsycasterPathDef.label: tranquilizer
VanillaPsycastsExpanded.PsycasterPathDef.description: Tranquilizer psycasts are focused on pacifying minds: sedating targets, shielding the caster's own psyche, and flooding whole areas with numbing calm or blind panic.
VanillaPsycastsExpanded.PsycasterPathDef.tooltip: Tranquilizers are psycasters who learned to lower the noise of other minds. They can put a single target into deep sedation, harden their own mind into a barrier, spread panic among attackers, or blanket a whole area in a serene field that sedates every hostile mind within it.
